}}'''Feragaine Saralman''' was an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Blue Ajah]] who was raised to the [[Amyrlin Seat]] in the year {{Ne|732}}.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Feragaine Saralman}}

==History==
Feragaine held the position for twenty-two years until her death in {{Ne|754}}. She was [[Marasale Jureen]]'s successor and [[Myriam Copan]]'s predecessor.{{ref|{{bwb}}, Chapter 24 The White Tower}}

Feragaine was in large part a puppet of the [[Hall of the Tower|Hall]], as her predecessor Marasale, she was chosen because the [[Sitters]] thought she was easily controlled by them, in fact in large part it happened.

She made some effort to restore her power and authority but was almost always outmanoeuvred. Her interests as in many from the Blue Ajah lay outside the [[White Tower]] and its politics and she floundered badly in the treacherous currents of the Hall.

During her reign the legendary [[Sereille Bagand]] was selected as Sitter by the [[White Ajah]], showing her remarkable qualities in a so influential Hall.
